proposal.observation: Round 1 caused a clear upstream regression: proxy_scaled fell from about 0.6296 to 0.4336, centreline residual rose from 23.2 cm to 47.0 cm, and depth NaNs rose from 24.5% to 55.8%. The new depth map has a large one-sided axial void, real detections fell to 18.2%, fallback rose to 81.8%, and ring-count error increased to 0.1. Orientation still passes, so this is not a handedness failure.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_1_centreline.f_curve_overfit induced by the round-1 cubic, tight-threshold, dense-slice combination. The unstable centre curve displaces a large part of the lining outside the usable unroll, causing depth holes and downstream fallback-dominated detection.
proposal.rationale: Recover by reversing all three causal unfolding changes together: return to a quadratic centre curve, relax RANSAC from 0.8 to the bounded midpoint 1.0, and restore moderate slice spacing at 1.8. Do not add a seed in this recovery round because a seed would confound attribution and merely freeze whichever fit the restored geometry produces. Leave denoising, detection, and SAM untouched so recovery is attributable to the stage-1 rollback.
